title: job.blocked
description: The job stopped moving without leaving the node — a fact about a flag, not about movement. Parity with flowpilot's EventKind.BLOCKED.

reason.description: Why it stopped, in free text. It does not replace the input request: when the block is a wait for a human, the content of what was asked lives in input_request.created.

consecutive_failures.description: How many failed sessions in a row, on the same job and the same node, raised the flag (t265). Present ONLY on the block the ceiling fired; absent from every other reason to stop — a failure before the session, an uncommitted job, a node with nobody to ask, an ordinary escalation — because none of them has a run behind it and writing a number there would invent a count nobody measured. Minimum 1: blocking with zero failures is not a ceiling, it is a defect.
